text: Astronomy is the study of the universe, which includes stars, planets, and galaxies. Telescopes are used to observe the night sky and search for celestial objects such as planets, comets, and stars. Nebulae are massive, dense regions of gas and dust believed to be the birthplaces of stars and galaxies. Understanding the structure of nebulae and their role in the formation of the universe is important to astronomers studying the cosmos.
